summary: Ericsson filed a 6-K announcing Per Narvinger as new President and CEO, succeeding Börje Ekholm who steps down on September 30, 2026, with an advisory role until June 2027. Narvinger, previously EVP and Head of Business Area Networks, will assume the role on October 1, 2026. The board describes this as a well-prepared, orderly succession. No price, premium, or deal terms are involved. The change is a planned, forced departure of the sitting CEO triggered by the filing. Watch for any strategic shifts under Narvinger's leadership and potential impact on Ericsson's stock.
